subject: Integration Showcase Series — Redwood + ConvergeOps (kickoff)
messages:
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Integration Showcase Series — Redwood + ConvergeOps (kickoff)

Hi Lena —

Great meeting last week. ConvergeOps and Redwood have a strong story to tell together (real-time routing + observability integrations) and we'd like to propose a short, three-part "Integration Showcase" series to drive joint lead gen and developer adoption. High-level we envision: 

- Session 1 (30 min): Platform orientation + integration architecture (developer audience)
- Session 2 (30 min): Live end-to-end demo + best practices for low-latency inference
- Session 3 (roundtable): Customer panel / lessons learned (product/ops audience)

Would ConvergeOps be open to co-hosting? Ideal window: mid-March — we can do the 2nd/3rd weeks. If you’re interested, can you share: target audience (devs/architects/pm), top KPIs (pipeline/conversion/SQLs), and any promo constraints? I attached a one-pager with our initial outline for your review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm interest + target date
2) Lock speakers and recording policy
3) Share copy for promotional assets & 2-week outreach cadence

Thanks — excited to collaborate.

— Priyom Das
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-integration-showcase-outline.docx

From: Lena Morales <lena@convergeops.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: ConvergeOps Partnerships <partnerships@convergeops.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Integration Showcase Series — Redwood + ConvergeOps (kickoff)

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — love the format. ConvergeOps is definitely interested. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Audience: primarily platform engineers and SREs at scale-up fintechs (we can broaden to product engineering if needed)
- KPIs: MQLs from developer signups, demo requests, 3-4 SQLs from the series
- Timing: March 16 or March 23 both look feasible for us (10:00 PT start preferred)

We do have one ask: can the first session be light on high-level marketing and heavier on the integration wiring — our audience wants actionable content. I attached a short case study that resonates with that crowd.

Happy to jump on a 30-min planning call next week to confirm speakers and assets.

Best,
Lena Morales
Head of Partnerships, ConvergeOps
lena@convergeops.com
Attachment: convergeops-case-study.pdf

Thanks, Priyom and Lena —

Love this. From a marketing ops perspective here's a practical playbook we can execute quickly: 

Proposed agenda for Session 1 (60 min total):
- 10m: quick intros & goals (hosts)
- 20m: integration architecture + common pitfalls (Redwood + ConvergeOps engineers)
- 20m: live demo (Connor)
- 10m: Q&A + CTA (demo sign-up + sandbox link)

Speaker suggestions: Priyom (host/co-host), Connor (live demo), Lena (customer framing), Jasmine (moderator). Monica — can you handle logistics (registration page, recording, and follow-up sequence)?

Promo plan (high level):
- 2-week email cadence to each company's developer lists
- Blog swap: short co-authored post the week of the session
- Social: 3 posts per company (announce, reminder, replay)

I attached a draft promo calendar and event checklist. We should lock date this week if March 16/23 works.

—Evelyn
Director, Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference
Attachment: mktg-promo-plan.xlsx

From: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Integration Showcase Series — Redwood + ConvergeOps (kickoff)

+1 on the agenda. A couple of technical notes for the live demo: 

- I'd like to use a pre-provisioned sandbox dataset (no PII) — does ConvergeOps have a sandbox we can access?
- SSH/SSO: if we're demonstrating SSO or SAML flows, we'll need a test tenant or a short IP allowlist for the demo infra (30 mins to verify).
- Runtime constraints: to show low-latency routing we'll demo a 2-model fallback; need ~2x GPU for burst testing if we do live throughput. Otherwise we can replay a recorded run.

If ConvergeOps can provide sandbox credentials and a test endpoint, I can build a 12-min demo script that highlights: integration wiring, KV cache benefit, and how to failover gracefully.
